scope: Base vector front filtering and sparse front overrides only.

implementation.defaultFront: coalesce(feature-state.front, c=1) preserves an explicit false override.
implementation.stateWrites: Observed tile edges no longer receive initial feature-state writes. Only restored/changed incident edges receive overrides that differ from the original border or mask exact front geometry.
implementation.lifetime: Repeated equal overrides are skipped. Overrides that return to the base value without an exact front are removed with removeFeatureState.
implementation.geometry: The initialIds -> incidentEdges -> stageDetail and updateWorld -> stageDetail paths remain authoritative. Non-c1 fronts retain complete exact geometry in OPERATIONAL_FRONT_SOURCE_ID, independently of selected-country detail.
implementation.originalBorders: Source-country identity determines the original border without consulting active countries. When liberation restores an original border through exact geometry, its base copy stays masked.
implementation.failures: Sparse set/remove failures retain the existing resyncRequired behavior. Revision, delta, staging and stale-request checks are unchanged.

contractImpact.mapPort: OperationalMapPort now requires MapLibre's existing removeFeatureState(target) method. The consumer fixture implements it; the real MapLibre Map already supports it.
contractImpact.projection: operationalCellView arguments and return fields are unchanged.
contractImpact.deliveryAndSources: No delivery API, transport, source identity, tile, catalog or approval data changes.
